summary.scenario: Actual 0.6.12 scheduled weapons against the exact two wave-38 variants at authored HP/armor/regeneration. One active attacker, no neighboring friendly offensive support; stationary victim inside attack range. Fixed high RNG avoids random critical/control/evasion procs. Knifemen are revealed by the authored close-defender reveal radius and retain their temporary disarm. No legal campaign win or player-save state is implied.

variant.name: Blood-Leech Trolls
variant.counter: Each invader independently becomes a cloaked Knifeman with close-range disarms or a regenerating Blood-Leech. Reveal Knifemen and block Blood-Leech healing.
variant.appearance: Knifemen are masked orcs who vanish into mist and disrupt defenders with cursed knives. Blood-Leeches are pale trolls who regenerate from red sacs on their backs.

notes: The Blood-Leech variant has no Physical or Magical immunity and explicitly disables inherited stealth and disarm.
It regenerates 25% of MAXIMUM health each simulation second: 7,842.25 HP/s at wave-38 HP 31,369. This exceeds many individual sustained attack profiles.
A Cancel Physical Immunity Aura has no damage multiplier effect on this non-immune enemy. It is not required to make Physical hits deal damage.
Positive damage is measured from actual owned HP-loss damage traces, even when regeneration subsequently restores all visible health.
This isolates the damage gate. A specific saved player army, placement, attack pause, route, concealment mix and retargeting state was not supplied.
